facts.fact: GovStack says Mauritania's digital ministry (MTNIMA) worked on a government architecture standard to improve interoperability, and a March 2026 national consultation of 118 representatives from 34 departments produced a reference framework drawing on GovStack and TOGAF; no adoption is stated.

GovStack says a government architecture standard for interoperability, security and service development was worked on with MTNIMA and put to a March 2026 national consultation; no publication is stated.
